figurative_meaning_en: A person with an intensely hateful or bigoted mentality
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে একটা জাতসাপ, কারো জাত দেখেই বিরক্ত হয়ে যায়।
গ্রামে সেই জাতসাপের কারণে অনেক ঝগড়া হয়েছে।
example_sentences_in_english: He is a real caste snake, getting irritated just by seeing someone's caste.
The village has seen many fights because of that hateful bigot.
note: Refers to deep-seated caste prejudice common in Bengali society
